verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Asana projects and tasks can be created and managed, including via the MCP server, and that it has a status-updates feature readable through the API. That is the core of tracking work with status. Nothing in the pack documents a priority field, an owning-team assignment, or an initiative-level object. Missing for 10: documented priority fields, team ownership of initiatives, initiative or portfolio-level tracking, and hands-on corroboration.
